subject: Physics
title: Grade 9 Olympiad Physics Core 1A Ontology: Motion in a Plane (Projectiles & Relative Frames)

structural_pillars.name: Orthogonal Planar Coordinate Decoupling
structural_pillars.statement: Motion in a plane decomposes into two mutually perpendicular 1D motions that evolve completely independently under a shared universal time parameter t.
structural_pillars.mathematical_invariant: a_x = 0 => v_x(t) = u cos theta = const; a_y = -g => v_y(t) = u sin theta - g t; r(t) = x(t) i_hat + y(t) j_hat
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Uniform vertical gravitational field without aerodynamic drag in Cartesian inertial frame.

structural_pillars.name: Vertical Free-Fall Clock Invariance
structural_pillars.statement: Vertical fall time from height h is governed strictly by vertical motion parameters and is completely invariant to horizontal launch speed.
structural_pillars.mathematical_invariant: t_f = sqrt(2h/g); At apex v_y = 0 => H = (u sin theta)^2 / (2g); T_flight = 2 u sin theta / g
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Level or elevated launch under uniform gravity g.

structural_pillars.name: Symmetric Trajectory Geometry & Range Invariants
structural_pillars.statement: Horizontal range on flat ground is maximized at launch angle 45 degrees; complementary angles theta and (90 - theta) yield identical range with different flight times.
structural_pillars.mathematical_invariant: R = u^2 sin(2 theta) / g; R(theta) = R(90 - theta); R_max = u^2 / g; R / H = 4 cot theta; T_1 T_2 = 2 R / g

structural_pillars.name: Cartesian Path Function & Geometric Trajectory Parabola
structural_pillars.statement: Eliminating time t from orthogonal component equations yields an explicit parabolic path function connecting spatial coordinates (x, y).
structural_pillars.mathematical_invariant: y(x) = x tan theta - (g x^2) / (2 u^2 cos^2 theta) = x tan theta [1 - x / R]
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Non-vertical launch u cos theta != 0 in Cartesian plane.

structural_pillars.name: Planar Relative Kinematics & Curvilinear Acceleration Invariants
structural_pillars.statement: Relative velocity transforms by vector subtraction v_{AB} = v_A - v_B; curvilinear acceleration decomposes into tangential rate of change of speed and normal centripetal rate of change of direction.
structural_pillars.mathematical_invariant: v_{boat/ground} = v_{boat/water} + v_{water}; a_{net} = sqrt(a_t^2 + a_n^2) where a_t = dv/dt, a_n = v^2 / rho
structural_pillars.scope_condition: Galilean planar reference frames and smooth osculating curvature paths.

nodes.term: River-Boat Shortest Time vs Zero Drift
Tangential vs Normal Acceleration in Curvature

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: At the highest point of projectile flight, the speed is zero because the ball momentarily stops.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: Only the vertical velocity component vanishes (v_y = 0). The horizontal velocity v_x = u cos theta remains unaffected, so total speed reaches a non-zero minimum v_min = u cos theta > 0.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: A horizontal ball launch or high-speed strobe photography of an oblique toss: ball continues travelling horizontally at apex.

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: A bullet fired horizontally hits the ground much later than a bullet dropped from the exact same height because the fired bullet 'flies'.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: Both bullets hit the ground at the exact same instant: t = sqrt(2h/g). Perpendicular horizontal motion cannot delay downward gravitational acceleration.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: Simultaneous electronic release of a dropped sphere and horizontally projected sphere: acoustic sensors detect simultaneous ground strike.

cognitive_conflict_matrix.intuitive_misconception: To cross a river in the shortest possible time, you must angle upstream so the current doesn't push you downstream.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.newtonian_scientific_truth: Aiming upstream reduces the across-river velocity component (v_y = v_bw cos theta < v_bw), making the trip take longer. Shortest time strictly requires aiming perpendicular to the banks (theta = 0 => t_min = d / v_bw), completely ignoring downstream drift.
cognitive_conflict_matrix.decisive_experiment: Motorboat trials with GPS timing: perpendicular heading achieves fastest bank-to-bank crossing despite downstream landing.
